# commercetools_integration_layer_checkout_rules (Resource)

The rules that pick the commercetools Checkout application a cart on the Commerce Integration Layer checks out with. The first rule matching the cart's country and store wins.

A Project has one list of rules, so define this resource once per Project. The API cannot remove the rules: destroying the resource only removes it from the state, and the rules stay in force.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_integration_layer_checkout_rules" "rules" {
  rule {
    countries       = ["DE", "AT"]
    application_key = "eu-checkout"
    mode            = "COMPLETE"
  }

  rule {
    stores          = ["vip-store"]
    application_key = "vip-checkout"
    mode            = "PAYMENT_ONLY"
  }

  # Matches every other cart, so it has to be last.
  rule {
    application_key = "default-checkout"
    mode            = "PAYMENT_ONLY"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `rule` (Block List) A rule, in order of precedence. A rule without `countries` and `stores` matches every cart, so it can only be the last. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The key of the Project the rules belong to.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `application_key` (String) Key of the commercetools Checkout application to check out with.
- `mode` (String) `COMPLETE` for the full checkout, `PAYMENT_ONLY` for payment only.

Optional:

- `countries` (List of String) Countries, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, of which the cart's must be one. Leave out to match any country.
- `stores` (List of String) Keys of the Stores of which the cart's must be one. Leave out to match any Store.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The checkout rules are a singleton per Project, so they are imported using
# the Project key.
terraform import commercetools_integration_layer_checkout_rules.rules my-project-key
```
